sloka: निकुम्भं च हतं श्रुत्वा कुम्भं च विनिपातितम्।रावणः परमामर्षी प्रजज्वालानलो यथा ।। ६.७८.१ ।।
transliteration: nikumbhaṁ ca hataṁ śrutvā kumbhaṁ ca vinipātitam।rāvaṇaḥ paramāmarṣī prajajvālānalo yathā ।। 6.78.1 ।।

translations.english: On hearing that Nikumbha and Kumbha had been killed, Ravana was very furious and burning in anger.
